source: Exact child-session event_msg/token_count cumulative total_token_usage, read once at final accounting milestone.
counterScope: Fresh no-history child session assignment only. First cumulative snapshot equals its last-request snapshot; no pre-assignment inherited cumulative counter was subtracted or included.
reportingTail: Unmeasured after fixed cutoff, including usage collection result processing, final artifact checks/writes, handoff and final report. Platform overhead is unknown. This is a measured subtotal, not a claim of final complete usage.
cost: not calculated;token counts are not monetary charges
